f.n: Bremer Australian Marine Park - National Park Zone - South-west
f.pu: To provide for the protection and conservation of ecosystems, habitats and native species in as natural a state as possible.
f.re: 1. Fishing is prohibited. Fishing gear must be kept stowed and secured at all times during transit. 2. Aquaculture is prohibited. 3. Mining operations are prohibited. 4. Dredging and disposal of dredged material is prohibited. 5. Fish aggregating devices are prohibited.
f.rn: South-west Marine Parks Network Management Plan 2018

f.pu: To provide protection and conservation for habitats and biodiversity.
f.re: 1.
